Hi All,
Thank you for your patience,

ARMSX1 0.1.6 has been released

Please read below the following changes

Bug Fixes
Adding a new backend core has fixed the below

Device testing will be needed but should have fixed the below

No more FPS drops and runs at a full 60fps

M3U now swaps disc correctly rather than opening up the file browser

Fixed FPS slow down on all resolutions settings

Runahead now runs a full 60fps

Fixed button scrolling within the UI

Features

Added HD support for all games under video - HD 2, HD 3 and HD 4 (HD 3 is the recemended setting)

Important to know the below

I have created a couple of my own cheats labeled experimental bu

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
# v0.4.8 主要更新

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

新增：手势模式，支持八种手势分别绑定功能，并可通过点击主球、侧滑唤起、左右旋转或前后倾斜触发。

新增：快捷面板，集中显示六种模式、语言方向和四个快捷操作，支持横竖屏布局。

新增：本地模型管理，支持下载模型、导入 GGUF、独立保存模型参数，以及使用相同原文试译比较。

新增：Index-Translate、Qwen3、LFM2.5、Gemma 和 TranslateGemma 等本地模型选择。

新增：Root 和无障碍截屏，支持自动选择可用方式，也可手动切换截屏方式。

新增：「B站翻译(免费)」，内置服务配置，选择后即可联网使用，感谢bilibili的免费翻译服务。

新增：「PP-OCRv5 东斯拉夫语」模型，支持俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语和英语识别。

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

新增：[Issue #31](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/31) 提出的阿拉伯语界面翻译，感谢 [Maxaseel](https://github.com/Maxaseel) 提供翻译。

优化：日漫 OCR 加速，**已下载旧版日漫模型的用户，可点击「补充下载」，在保持识别精度的同时加快识别，无需删除重下。** 同时优化 PaddleOCR 识别，减少重复识别和图案误识别，改善漫画原文擦除、背景修复及译文排版，减少残字、越界和排版拥挤。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：悬浮球设置分组，将贴边、菜单按钮、触发方式和手势绑定分别整理到独立页面，统一模式切换提示。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

优化：初始化引导选择日文、韩文、俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语、中文或英文时会匹配对应 OCR；其它源语言默认推荐 PaddleOCR v5 mobile。

优化：相册图片导入与系统分享流程，改善批量翻译任务的创建和处理体验。

优化：模型下载进度、速度显示、失败恢复和就绪检查，整理语音模型下载状态展示；完善本地翻译模型的加载方式、旧配置迁移与资源释放。

优化：设置保存、预设管理、首页提示与词典交互，改善识别、屏幕旋转和循环翻译时的显示，减少配置丢失及使用过程中的崩溃。

releases.name: v0.4.7

新增：PaddleOCR 支持韩文识别。

新增：小牛翻译，可在翻译引擎中选择并配置使用。

新增：LLM 服务商预设，支持查看官方文档、测试连接和获取模型列表；API Key 需自行填写。

新增：[Issue #23](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/23) 提出的快捷设置磁贴，可快速启动或停止截屏服务。

新增：[Issue #22](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/22) 提出的画面方向修正，支持手机竖屏但游戏内容横屏等场景。

新增：翻译库支持「全部停用」，无需逐项关闭。

新增：关于页面增加「使用手册」入口，方便查看功能说明和操作步骤。

新增：开发者选项增加全屏共享开关，开启后请求共享整个屏幕。

优化：改善漫画文字识别和译文显示效果。

优化：改善朗读语言判断、权限处理和服务商配置体验。

优化：提取文字支持悬浮窗口的合并强度设置，显示、复制和朗读使用相同的分段结果。

修复：模型下载失败、断点续传异常及配套模型未自动下载的问题。

修复：自动识别韩文时可能识别错误或只返回标点的问题。

修复：多种语言同时出现时，自动识别可能选错识别结果、遗漏部分文字的问题。

修复：切换应用语言后，部分悬浮菜单、翻译卡片和选框按钮仍显示原来语言的问题。

releases.body:
# v0.4.5 主要更新

新增：术语库支持从 JSON 文件批量导入，可在导入前预览、筛选并处理重复内容。

新增：悬浮窗支持点击英文单词查看简要释义，并可打开完整词卡。

新增：实验性支持将当前画面随翻译发送给兼容的 LLM，用于辅助判断阅读顺序、识别内容和画面语境。该功能默认关闭。不同多模态模型的识别能力差异较大，暂时不能保证提高文字识别质量；开启后还会增加等待时间和调用费用，请根据所用模型的实际效果选择。

优化：完善思考模式、推理强度、图片清晰度和自定义请求参数等 LLM 设置。

优化：调整日文、中文、韩文和拉丁文字识别流程，并改进 Paddle OCR 的批量识别与竖排文字处理。

优化：改进同屏、连续和全部合并翻译的顺序、结果对应与异常恢复，减少重复请求和翻译失败。

优化：统一欢迎页与设置页的模型推荐、下载检查和离线方案选择。

优化：提升 Shizuku 及部分兼容实现的适配稳定性。

修复：若干悬浮窗、原文覆盖、设置状态和界面显示问题。

- Winlator Cmod development continues!
- My focus on next release will either be mostly QoL. This means addressing long standing bug fixes, but more importantly, **merging and crediting improvements from other forks of Cmod from trusted developers.** Primarily I'll be focused on:
- Fixing dynamic package name paths for the gamepad implementation so that name can be changed, such as adding a ludashi benchmark version with the SDL joystick native controller support.
- Input control / touch screen control bindings bug fixes
- Minor UI improvements and enhancements
- Updating all drivers, Fex, Box64, and graphics Wrapper, following Pipetto-Crypto's advice when it comes to Streamlining and avoiding feature creep (...and avoiding pure AI code slop).

This update includes a huge number of fixes for a smoother experience.

### Statement on BrunoSX’s hiatus
Bruno (@brunodev85) announced he’s pausing Winlator development after false virus accusations. There are no viruses in Winlator, at least not intentionally—debug symbols in the bundled Wine builds can trigger antivirus heuristics, but I realize that the latest release had something a bit different that scrambled executable file names. The reality is that these things can happen, it's certainly not intentional. *Update: TestD3D.exe _was_ infected with floxif. Again, this was not intentional, but it should be noted.  

### Where Cmod & the Bionic fork stand
My own Cmod branch has been quiet since Prototype 5 / v12 alpha (Discord-only). Meanwhile, amazing work continues:

@Pipetto-crypto – Bionic & graphics wrappers

@cjxyz – Bionic Winlator fork and new features

### My roadmap
I’m resuming work—slowly, around a busier job—but the plan is:

🔧 Fix Gamepad Configurator

🖥️ Streamline Big Picture Mode (Cmod Big Picture Mode, the frontend looking menu I made a while back. But Steam support is still on my radar)

🍷 Update Wine & core assets

🏷️ Expand on shortcut settings / per-app tweaks

Expect incremental releases rather than one big drop.

This release finalizes the 5.0 series.

Emulation accuracy
- New option CPU_START_DELAY staggers the CPU start relative to the beam. Without it, some memory configurations always hit a timing race in Kickstart 1.3’s PAL/NTSC detection (#1029).
- Reinstated the ADF track-length fix that had been dropped by mistake (#1021).

Usability
- Improved auto-warp condition (#1008).
- “Close unsaved instances without asking” now works reliably.
- Choosing the Performance preset no longer wipes the saved collision-detection defaults.

Under the hood
- Public API cleanup
- Detailed API documentation at https://dirkwhoffmann.github.io/vAmiga/docs/index.html

Enhancements: 
- Moira now emulates the 68020 instruction cache.

Bug fixes:
- Improved AGA support (#999, #1003, #1004, #1009, #1011, #1012, #1013).

New features: 
- AGA support

# Release Notes

## Enhancements

- The floppy disk API now supports disk images stored in memory buffers (#992)
- Added proper gamma correction to the palette builders (#998)
- Replaced the 4096-entry palette lookup table with a smaller table based on an affine transformation, paving the way for AGA support.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that caused the server launch daemon to fire every cycle (#990)
- Fixed a bug that prevented preferences from loading correctly (#995)
- Added guard checks for potential Swift `nil` values
- Fixed a bug in the **Export to…** menu (#989)
- Reverted pull request #837 (#984)

Ending the beta phase, as no severe bugs have been reported recently.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue that prevented folders from being imported as hard drives (#975)

Some players got a "Threat found" warning from Windows Defender for
`nectar-launcher.exe` (`Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml`). This was a false
positive. The `!ml` means it came from Defender's machine-learning guess,

texture packs, and the exe had no publisher or version info. This release

# Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0

基于 [Winlator 11.1](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) 深度定制:

## 主要变化
- **Wine 10.10 -> Wine 11.15**: 移植 brunodev85 全部定制补丁 (Android 存储符号链接、GPU 信息上报、X11 窗口属性等) 至 Wine 11.15 新 WoW64 模式 (x86_64-unix + i386/x86_64 双架构 PE)
- **esync -> fastsync**: 移除旧 esync 机制, 使用 Wine 11 原生 fastsync, 同步性能更好
- **完整中文支持**:
  - Android 界面全面中文翻译 (values-zh-rCN)
  - 内置 Noto Sans CJK SC 中文字体 + fontconfig 中文别名
  - rootfs 注入 zh_CN.UTF-8 locale (glibc + X11)
  - Wine 前缀注册表中文字体替换 (宋体/SimSun -> Noto Sans CJK SC)
  - 新建容器默认中文环境

## 下载安装
直接下载下方 APK (约 325 MB) 安装即可, 无需额外组件。首次启动会自动解包 rootfs。

## 技术说明
- APK 为 debug 签名, 与官方 Winlator 签名不同, 两者不可互相覆盖安装
- 由 GitHub Actions 全自动云端编译: Wine (约 50 分钟) -> rootfs 注入中文化 -> Gradle 打包
- 构建配方见仓库 `wine/`、`chinese/`、`.github/workflows/build.yml`

Beta 0.3

This update focuses on speed. On my Galaxy S24 Ultra (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3) Cascade now runs at about 58-60 fps, a pretty good improvement from about 44 in 0.2. # reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

releases.body:
**RedU v1.0.5** — el port para Android de *New Super Mario Bros. U*: recompilación nativa, no es un emulador.

### Qué hay de nuevo

- **Reloj al 100%**: un botón en Ajustes → Android que le pide al teléfono correr a su frecuencia máxima y dice exactamente qué permitió el teléfono. En un teléfono sin root el botón informa y apunta al modo de juego del teléfono o a `adb shell cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true`.
- **Aviso de refresco**: los ajustes avisan cuando los cuadros por segundo están por encima de los de la pantalla (esas imágenes nunca se ven y le roban la GPU al juego).
- **Nota sobre los drivers propios**: los ajustes explican que se puede instalar un driver Vulkan propio (Turnip) para el Adreno, que arregla errores gráficos y puede ir más rápido.
- **Guardia de calor**: ahora lee el estado térmico del teléfono cuando este no informa cuánto margen térmico queda; antes no pausaba nunca.
- **Arreglo del enlace**: la preparación ya no se cae al enlazar el juego en el teléfono.

releases.body:
- **Smooth mouse in Crusader Kings III.** The game now runs at up to 60 fps instead of 30, so zooming the map with the mouse wheel and moving the pointer no longer go in steps. It holds 54-59 fps in the busiest scene. The app still lowers the frame rate by itself if the tablet gets hot.
- Helpers 40, Box64 pp13, Mesa Turnip pp10.

releases.name: Pons 0.5.1
releases.body:
- **Fixed: "Security warning" from ColorOS.** On OnePlus and Oppo tablets, 0.5.0 made the system show "an attempt by a malicious app to damage the system has been stopped" a few seconds after Steam started. Nothing was damaged; a change meant to save CPU in Steam triggered the check, and it is gone.
- **Cooler by default.** New installs start at 1280×904 (Fast): same 30 fps in Crusader Kings III with the GPU about 7 °C cooler. A resolution you already picked is kept.
- Helpers 39, Box64 pp13, Mesa Turnip pp10.

Install: download pons-0.5.1.apk below. Experimental.

releases.name: Pons 0.5.0
releases.body:
- **Mouse and keyboard work like on a desktop.** Left, right and middle click, scroll wheel, drag, and keyboard shortcuts go straight to the game. Touch gestures for tablets without a mouse.
- **Less memory.** Box64 pp13: Crusader Kings III uses about 0.6 GB less RAM.
- **Less CPU.** Steam and the game talk to each other without going through proot each time: proot stops fell from about 3,750 to 300 per second, and the app uses about 20% less CPU in game. Same 30 fps.
- **Fixed: Android keyboard bar over the game** when a hardware keyboard is connected.
- Helpers 38, Box64 pp13, Mesa Turnip pp10.

Install: download pons-0.5.0.apk below. Experimental.

releases.name: Pons 0.4.0
releases.body:
- **Steam ready ahead.** When Pons opens, Steam starts and signs in in the background; Play then starts the game inside that session. Crusader Kings III reaches its menu in about 29 s instead of 46. A setting turns it off.
- **Fixed: black screen after leaving the game.** Coming back to the game screen now shows the game again.
- Helpers 35, Box64 pp12, Mesa Turnip pp10.

Install: download pons-0.4.0.apk below. Experimental.

releases.name: Pons 0.3.0
releases.body:
- **Much faster downloads and starts on some networks.** Linux now uses the DNS servers of the network Android is on (and follows network changes). Before, a fixed DNS server that some hotspots and VPNs drop made every lookup wait 5 seconds: Steam downloaded at 0.03 Mbps instead of 22, and signing in took a minute.
- **Loading screen.** No more black screen on first start: a progress bar for the setup and Steam's update, the step in progress, and the game's artwork behind.
- Helpers 34, Box64 pp12, Mesa Turnip pp10.

Install: download pons-0.3.0.apk below. Experimental.

releases.name: ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1 — Despliegue Móvil Autónomo 1-Tap
releases.body:
# Notas de la Versión — ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1 (Oficial)

## 🚀 Resumen de la Versión 1.1 (2026-11-02) — Despliegue Móvil Autónomo 1-Tap (Cero PC / Cero Cables)

**ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1** introduce la arquitectura de instalación completamente autónoma para smartphones y tabletas Android, eliminando al 100% la necesidad de ordenadores, cables USB y depuración ADB:

1. **Preset Soberano Embebido:** La APK incorpora la preconfiguración oficial de Project Jaina en español (`Project Jaina - Datos del Juego`), con la URL directa de Internet Archive precargada y botón de acción directa `[Descargar Juego]`.
2. **Streaming por Rangos HTTP 206:** Integración con el motor de streaming nativo de WoW-Imito (`RemoteZipChannel` + `PublicZipInstaller`), desempaquetando los 16.23 GB directamente en el almacenamiento interno sin requerir duplicación de espacio (ahorro de 16 GB en el teléfono).
3. **Resistencia a Caídas y Descarga en Segundo Plano:** La descarga corre mediante `ForegroundService` con `WakeLock`, permitiendo apagar la pantalla o minimizar la app sin interrumpir la transferencia, con capacidad de reanudación automática ante pérdidas temporales de conexión Wi-Fi.

releases.body:
## ProjectJaina-Imito v1.0 — Lanzamiento Oficial para JainaCore (WoW 3.3.5a ARM64 / Android 12+)

Cliente móvil de alto rendimiento optimizado para teléfonos, tabletas y consolas portátiles Android (Snapdragon, Dimensity, Odin 2, Retroid, Razer Edge).

### Novedades & Características:
- **Motor de Emulación:** Box64 v0.4.5 + Wine 10.10 con parches de estabilidad gráfica.
- **Drivers Gráficos:** Mesa Turnip 26.1.0 (Adreno) y Vortek 2.1 / VirGL (Mali).
- **Modo ECO (40 FPS Cap):** Reduce calentamiento y prolonga la batería en sesiones largas.
- **Controles Integrados:** Soporte dual para pantalla táctil (Touch UI) y mandos físicos por Bluetooth/USB (ConsolePortLK).
- **Conectividad Multi-Reino:** Preconfigurado para Reino 1 JainaCore (Vanilla Cap 60), Reino 3 WanitosGYM (ICC Cap 80) y Túnel Remoto Global Playit.
- **Seguridad:** Alineado a 4 bytes y firmado digitalmente con Esquema v3 de Android.
